instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Answer the Saved examples page: list my saved examples, save one from its link, remove one", and give it path (The page route after /work/api: /saved-examples, /saved-examples/remove); method.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:answer-the-saved-examples-page and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: The Saved examples page's routes (GET /saved-examples lists every example newest first with its count; POST /saved-examples saves one from { url, title?, words?, pictures?, why_it_worked?, collection?, added_from?

4. It reads no store: the saved-example rows the AI hands in as stored.records come from the person's own store, and the rows it hands back in keep are written there (a value of null removes an example). To list or remove examples without the page, use workflow:keep-saved-examples (tools/workflows).
